items.title: 網擎策略投資微智安聯，臺灣資安業者攜手擴大產品布局、拓展海外市場
items.summary: 以郵件伺服器、郵件雲與郵件安全系統著稱的網擎資訊（Openfind），近期特別召開記者會，說明今年營運狀況、財務表現之餘，也談到近期運用AI強化技術應用研發，並宣布策略投資新創公司微智安聯（Shield eXtreme），可望攜手開拓海外市場，網擎同時揭露經營日本與奈及利亞市場的現況。

items.title: improve: show complete 30-day Usage reports sooner (#203346)
items.summary: improve: show complete 30-day Usage reports sooner (#203346) Show complete 30-day Usage reports sooner when durable summaries are missing. Reuse established checkpoint freshness, keep physical or unmeasured reads conservatively paced, and avoid rereading provider plans for session progress. Apply both preset dates at once while preserving manual edit debounce. Keep partial reports labeled, reports scoped, and foreground history responsive during backfill. Co-authored-by: vyctorbrzezowski
